assessments.reasoning: Ecma International publishes the controlling ECMA-262 15th-edition algorithm. Fresh direct acquisition returned the exact registered source SHA-256. Steps 3–7 distinguish reading an own data value from the calls for an own accessor descriptor. In ECMAScript 2024, OrdinaryGet returns undefined for an own accessor descriptor with an undefined getter. When the getter exists, it calls that getter with the original Receiver as the this argument. OrdinaryGet receives an own accessor descriptor after its GetOwnProperty operation completes normally. This concerns the accessor branch. The separate data, missing descriptor, and other internal-method algorithms have their own rules. A getter call can throw. The data branch bypasses Call, and the missing-descriptor branch can delegate to a prototype. The accessor branch preserves the receiver even when it differs from the own property holder.
